entries.title: Terahertz light distinguishes two groups of particles trapped inside superconducting vortices
entries.summary: Scientists at Rutgers and in Estonia have used invisible light to look into tiny magnetic whirlpools, called vortices, inside a superconductor, revealing details that could help researchers develop better materials for carrying electricity.

entries.title: Unusual quantum states in six-layer graphene offer clues to superconductivity
entries.summary: Graphene, a material consisting of a sheet of carbon atoms arranged in a honeycomb pattern, has proved promising for various technological applications. Materials in which several layers of graphene are stacked together can exhibit different advantageous properties.
